messages:
maria: FYI overnight autoscaler churn in apac-us pool dropped the tag init hook for ephemeral VMs. The nightly label-attach missed ~7,320 USD. Many lines show as `unallocated`. Need to decide allocation and get JE.

cost-bot: cost-reconcile-run: https://redwood.internal/costs/apac/3181234567-recon.csv (rows: 412). Suspicious cluster: apac-us-spot-pool-7, window 2026-03-22T23:00-00:30.

oz: rough split from heuristics: Ads-ML 3,900; Realtime-Infra 2,200; Experiments 1,220. I can drop a proposal if finance wants to rebill.

leo (finance): For any rebill > $2k we need engineering and product leads inline. Also need cost_center and ledger strings.

tara (eng-infra): we'll add a post-deploy hook to re-run the tag attach on node join; short-term patch today. For this event though, ok to rebill per heuristics.

maria: tagging product owners: @amy-ads, @devon-exp. Amy replied :ok_hand: (ads signoff). Devon asked for breakdown by cluster name; oz posted filtered rows.

oz: pasted summary CSV slice:
```
cluster,project_label,heuristic_score,amount
apac-us-spot-pool-7,ads-ml,0.92,3900
apac-us-spot-pool-7,realtime-infra,0.78,2200
apac-us-spot-pool-7,experiments,0.65,1220
```

leo (finance): OK to proceed once JIRA ticket exists. Use ledger: LDG-CORE-APAC and cost_center: CC-ENG-ADS for Ads, CC-INFRA for Realtime, CC-RND for Experiments. JE narrative: "Reallocation due to tag attach failure during autoscaler churn - apac-us-3181234567".

maria: created JIRA FIN-2026-78 "APAC autoscaler tag-attach missed - rebill 3181234567". Assigning to @oz to run rebill script.

oz: running rebill now. Quick preview:
```
ads-ml,3900,LDG-CORE-APAC,CC-ENG-ADS
realtime-infra,2200,LDG-CORE-APAC,CC-INFRA
experiments,1220,LDG-CORE-APAC,CC-RND
```

cost-bot: rebill executed; created JE JE-2026-APAC-3181234567 link: https://redwood.internal/journal/JE-2026-APAC-3181234567.csv. Attached to JIRA FIN-2026-78.

leo (finance): recorded. Leaving audit note: "heuristic allocation used; owner signoffs cached in slack thread; follow-up: eng to add post-join hook and alert if unlabeled > $1k per window".

tara (eng-infra): will push guard in next patch. Thanks all.
notes: autoscaler bug caused tag attach loss; heuristic rebill executed; JIRA and JE created; engineering follow-up scheduled
